[B1] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : false , 'buttonPressed' : OldPressed , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | Key .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendKey' UserX | Key
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , 'key' : Key , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , 'key' : Key , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'owner' : UserX , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'reset' cloudA | deviceB
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'resetDevice' deviceB .
[B5] < deviceB | 'online' : true , 'owner' : UserOwner , ... > $ cloudA 'resetDevice' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'online' : false , 'owner' : nils , ... > .
